tests: How to forcibly deny actions outside the allowed Region across all accounts in the organization.
expected: An SCP on the root/OU with Deny for EC2 outside eu-west-1 (aws:RequestedRegion condition) — a guardrail no IAM policy can bypass. Triggers: "across all accounts in AWS Organization", "only in region X", "enforce".
why_not: IAM policies and permissions boundaries — per-principal, easy to miss or get wrong; AWS Config only detects after the fact, doesn't prevent.
